status: sound comparison only; no pronunciation grade
reason: The TIMIT recognizer increases coverage and detects more annotated errors but also doubles the false-positive rate on the shared inventory. Neither reaches adequate precision for error labels. Keep the original recognizer for side-by-side estimated sounds, with low-confidence results withheld.
